# tomswallapi_snat (Resource)

A source-NAT / masquerade intent. It renders on devices that bind the egress zone (and, for a zone source, that zone too) — auto-scoping masquerade to edges.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_snat" "masq_loc" {
  action = "masquerade"
  source = "loc"
  egress = "net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) masquerade or snat.
- `egress` (String) Egress zone; resolved per device to its egress interface via bindings.
- `source` (String) Source zone name or a literal CIDR to masquerade/SNAT.

### Optional

- `address` (String) For snat: the address (or range) to rewrite the source to.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `probability` (Number) Match probability (0-1) for load-balanced SNAT.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_snat.masq_loc 42
```
